d:
Anant Singh Statement : patna snatak nirvachan kshetr ke MLC chunav men niraj kumar ki jit ke bad vidhayak anant sinh ka bara bayan samne aaya hai. anant sinh ne niraj kumar ko badhaee dene se inkar karte hue kaha ki vah apne virodhi ko badhaee kyon denge.
Anant sinh ne anuj sinh ke samarthan, niraj kumar se apni narajgi aur JDU se nishkasan par bhi khulkar bat ki. unhonne kaha ki unhen parti se kabhi narajgi nahin thi, balki niraj kumar se narajgi ke karan unhonne jan suraj ke ummidvar ka samarthan kiya tha.
Dekhie patna MLC chunav ke natijon par anant sinh ka pura bayana.
